title: LLMENAS: Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search via Large Language Model Guidance

mechanism.domainTask: Neural architecture search for image classification
mechanism.populationDetail: CMA-ES samples a flat population of architecture vectors (lambda=25 on CIFAR and 50 on ImageNet) from an evolving Gaussian distribution.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The best architecture from each evolutionary generation is recorded in D; the final search path is selected from this temporal sequence. D is not a bounded top-k or quality-diversity archive.
mechanism.replacementDetail: CMA-ES refreshes sampled candidate populations generation by generation and updates its distribution from top-mu candidates; D separately accumulates each generation's best candidate for later path selection.
mechanism.generationDetail: Relative to the LLM-generated fitness-function artifact, initialization designs from trajectory context, reflection proposes a novel strategy after stagnation, and refinement retains core logic while tuning coefficients.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: The explicit trigger is structured validation-loss change and trajectory metrics. Natural-language analysis/directive is produced by the same LLM fitness designer, not by a separate architecture evaluator.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Parent-selection label describes CMA-ES distribution update over architecture candidates. It is separate from the LLM's one prior-code context in refinement; the two search levels should not be conflated.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: The LLM operates at a meta-optimization level: it generates and self-improves the evolutionary fitness function/controller, while CMA-ES rather than the LLM generates architecture candidates.
